semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-end quartz components specifically for semiconductor equipment.
summary: Zhejiang Hongxin New Materials Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the research, development, production, and sales of advanced quartz components for semiconductor manufacturing. Established in 2018, the company leverages a skilled workforce with extensive experience in the semiconductor industry to meet OEM standards for material requirements and production control.
capabilities: High-end quartz components for semiconductor equipment
Machining and flame working of quartz materials
Chemical cleaning processes meeting OEM standards

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Quzhou City, Zhejiang Province, and has a significant manufacturing presence there.
